selection: Final bars and updatedBars, latest ingest/source/universe/content ordering per symbol and exact event instant
provenance: Retrospective event-time archive; original runtime availability and executable quotes not established. Warmup only, separate from scored corpus.
calendarSource: signal.exchange_sessions_v1, provider alpaca, America/New_York, unique regular hours

queries.query: SELECT symbol,concat(replaceOne(toString(event_at,'UTC'),' ','T'),'Z'),b.1,b.2,b.3,b.4,b.5,b.6 FROM (SELECT symbol,coalesce(event_ts_exact,toDateTime64(event_ts,9,'UTC')) event_at,argMax(tuple(open,high,low,close,volume,ifNull(vwap,(high+low+close)/3)), tuple(coalesce(ingest_ts_exact,toDateTime64(ingest_ts,9,'UTC')),source_topic,source_partition,source_offset,universe_id,universe_symbol_hash,channel,tuple(open,high,low,close,volume,ifNull(vwap,(high+low+close)/3)))) b FROM signal.intraday_bars_1m_v2 WHERE event_ts >= '2026-08-04 00:00:00' AND event_ts < '2026-08-25 00:00:00' AND ingest_ts < '2026-11-26 08:40:00' AND feed = 'iex' AND provider = 'alpaca' AND is_final = 1 AND channel IN ('bars','updatedBars') AND symbol IN ('SPY','QQQ','NVDA','AAPL','MSFT','AMZN','GOOGL','META','TSLA','AMD','AVGO','COHR','CRDO','INTC','LITE','MRVL','MU','NFLX','SNDK','WDC','SMH','IWM') GROUP BY symbol,event_at) ORDER BY symbol,event_at FORMAT TSV
queries.metadataQuery: SELECT count() AS rawRows,uniqExact(tuple(symbol,coalesce(event_ts_exact,toDateTime64(event_ts,9,'UTC')))) AS uniqueSymbolInstants,groupUniqArray(universe_id) AS universes,groupUniqArray(channel) AS channels,min(ingest_ts) AS firstIngest,max(ingest_ts) AS lastIngest,countIf(vwap IS NULL) AS nullVwapRows FROM signal.intraday_bars_1m_v2 WHERE event_ts >= '2026-08-04 00:00:00' AND event_ts < '2026-08-25 00:00:00' AND ingest_ts < '2026-11-26 08:40:00' AND feed = 'iex' AND provider = 'alpaca' AND is_final = 1 AND channel IN ('bars','updatedBars') AND symbol IN ('SPY','QQQ','NVDA','AAPL','MSFT','AMZN','GOOGL','META','TSLA','AMD','AVGO','COHR','CRDO','INTC','LITE','MRVL','MU','NFLX','SNDK','WDC','SMH','IWM') FORMAT JSONEachRow
queries.conflictQuery: SELECT count() AS conflictingSymbolInstants,sum(revisions) AS contentVersions FROM (SELECT symbol,coalesce(event_ts_exact,toDateTime64(event_ts,9,'UTC')) event_at,uniqExact(tuple(open,high,low,close,volume,vwap)) revisions FROM signal.intraday_bars_1m_v2 WHERE event_ts >= '2026-08-04 00:00:00' AND event_ts < '2026-08-25 00:00:00' AND ingest_ts < '2026-11-26 08:40:00' AND feed = 'iex' AND provider = 'alpaca' AND is_final = 1 AND channel IN ('bars','updatedBars') AND symbol IN ('SPY','QQQ','NVDA','AAPL','MSFT','AMZN','GOOGL','META','TSLA','AMD','AVGO','COHR','CRDO','INTC','LITE','MRVL','MU','NFLX','SNDK','WDC','SMH','IWM') GROUP BY symbol,event_at HAVING revisions>1) FORMAT JSONEachRow
queries.calendarQuery: SELECT toString(session_date) AS date,any(open_time) AS open,any(close_time) AS close,replaceAll(any(open_time),':','') AS session_open,replaceAll(any(close_time),':','') AS session_close FROM signal.exchange_sessions_v1 WHERE session_date>='2026-08-04' AND session_date<='2026-08-24' AND provider='alpaca' AND timezone='America/New_York' GROUP BY session_date HAVING uniqExact(tuple(open_time,close_time))=1 ORDER BY session_date FORMAT JSONEachRow
queries.coverageQuery: SELECT symbol,uniqExact(toDate(event_ts,'America/New_York')) sessionDates,uniqExact(tuple(symbol,coalesce(event_ts_exact,toDateTime64(event_ts,9,'UTC')))) distinctSymbolInstants,min(event_ts) firstEvent,max(event_ts) lastEvent FROM signal.intraday_bars_1m_v2 WHERE event_ts >= '2026-08-04 00:00:00' AND event_ts < '2026-08-25 00:00:00' AND ingest_ts < '2026-11-26 08:40:00' AND feed = 'iex' AND provider = 'alpaca' AND is_final = 1 AND channel IN ('bars','updatedBars') AND symbol IN ('SPY','QQQ','NVDA','AAPL','MSFT','AMZN','GOOGL','META','TSLA','AMD','AVGO','COHR','CRDO','INTC','LITE','MRVL','MU','NFLX','SNDK','WDC','SMH','IWM') GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY symbol FORMAT JSONEachRow
